notes: Sacred Ground celestial dual cadence — America/Chicago. Night-before @ 7pm week_ahead + morning-of @ 9am today. Each event has distinct night + morning plates. Wired via config/celestial_events.json. See docs/CELESTIAL-NIGHT-CREATIVES.md.

events.title: Total Solar Eclipse in Leo
events.palette: void black, molten gold, ember corona, deep eggplant
events.composition: Diamond-ring total eclipse as hero; Leo mane formed from fire-corona rays swirling around the eclipsed sun; tight poster crop, not landscape vista
events.sg_anchor: tiny circular folk-art SG sun as a jewel in the outer corona / bat-signal fleck
events.avoid: milky way, aurora, soft landscape, daytime sun face dominating sky
events.one_liner: Black-gold diamond-ring poster with Leo fire-mane corona — not another space vista.

events.title: Perseids Peak
events.palette: warm amber meteor streaks, indigo night, neon magenta accent
events.composition: Diagonal calligraphy of meteor streaks cutting the frame; rooftop / street silhouette low; motion energy, not static stars
events.sg_anchor: glowing SACRED GROUND neon on rooftop edge
events.avoid: cool blue aurora clones, generic starfield with random streaks
events.one_liner: Warm amber meteor calligraphy over neon rooftop — kinetic, not aurora soup.

events.title: Partial Lunar Eclipse in Pisces
events.palette: blood-amber eclipsed moon, deep teal ocean, pearl mist
events.composition: Half-shadowed moon over rolling night sea; faint fish constellation in mist; wet reflective foreground
events.sg_anchor: SACRED GROUND glowing in wet-sand / water reflection
events.avoid: sharp NASA-style moon photo, firefly meadow, milky way arch
events.one_liner: Watercolor blood-amber moon over teal Pisces sea with name in the tide.

events.title: New Moon in Virgo
events.medium: deep cosmic jewel-tone night sky + gold sacred geometry
events.palette: indigo-violet void, emerald/amethyst nebula, luminous antique gold
events.composition: Round dark new moon; gold flower-of-life; Virgo wheat + glyph; morning keeps Founder Birthday Month honor line; cool sacred not cream birthday-card
events.avoid: cream parchment scrapbook look, white/blur box artifacts, prices
events.one_liner: Cosmic cool Virgo new moon — Founder Birthday Month honored through beauty.

events.title: Autumn Equinox
events.palette: harvest gold dusk LEFT / indigo night RIGHT, equal weight
events.composition: Exact vertical balance line; day-night duality; storefront straddles the seam
events.sg_anchor: lit Sacred Ground eggplant-awning storefront on the divide
events.avoid: single-sky gradients, generic autumn leaf piles without duality
events.one_liner: Split harvest-gold / indigo night with storefront on the equinox seam.

events.title: Full Moon in Aries
events.palette: copper-red moon, volcanic ember, charcoal, gold sparks
events.composition: Massive full moon with ram-horn silhouette carved into the limb; aggressive warm fire energy
events.sg_anchor: SACRED GROUND in searchlight beams under the moon
events.avoid: soft pastel moon lakes, gentle romantic moonlight
events.one_liner: Copper Aries ram-horn moon poster — fiery, not soft moonlit lake.

events.title: New Moon in Libra
events.palette: rose-gold, silver, deep plum, black lacquer
events.composition: Perfect bilateral symmetry; twin crescent scales of night; architectural framing
events.sg_anchor: circular SG logo as the fulcrum of the scales
events.one_liner: Art-deco Libra scales with SG logo as fulcrum — geometry, not sky photo.

events.title: Orionids Peak
events.composition: Orion constellation drawn sharp as architecture; meteor radiant from Orion; colder than Perseids
events.sg_anchor: circular SG sun bat-signal over misty hills
events.avoid: warm amber Perseids twin, soft firefly glow
events.one_liner: Icy cyan Orion architecture + meteor radiant — cold twin to Perseids.

events.title: Full Moon in Taurus
events.palette: cream-gold harvest moon, ochre orchard, warm brown earth
events.composition: Low huge moon over autumn orchard; grounded terrestrial calm; opposite of Aries fire
events.sg_anchor: lit eggplant-awning Sacred Ground storefront under the moon
events.avoid: fiery red moon, abstract graphic posters
events.one_liner: Cream harvest Taurus moon over orchard storefront — earthy, not Aries fire.

events.title: Samhain
events.palette: indigo-black veil, marigold orange, candle amber
events.composition: Veil-thin doorway of ancestral light; candle paths; mystical not cartoon Halloween
events.sg_anchor: Sacred Ground windows glowing like lanterns through autumn fog
events.avoid: cartoon jack-o-lantern clutter (generic Halloween plate already covers that)
events.one_liner: Marigold veil + lantern storefront — sacred Samhain, not cartoon Halloween.
